title: BUXUS
text: BUXUS, in botany, a genus of the monocina terrandia elids. The calix of the male coaffins of three leaves; and the crotilla has two petals: The calix of the fo- male has four leaves; the petals are three; it has three flyily, and the copfila has three cells containing two feeds. There is but one species, viz, the fampevi-rens, or box-tree, a native of Britain. A decdition of the leaves and wood has been recommended as a powerful fiducifie; but is not now used by prestitioners. The wood is of a hard clole texture, and is greatly used by mechanics for toßls of various kinds.
